experiences.description: Comprehensive foundational year in IT, covering the core principles of software development, networking, operating systems, databases, security and project management. Built various practical applications using Java, Python and web technologies and gained experience with Spring Boot, MySQL, Firebase and IoT. Learned to work with Agile methods, version control (Git) and gained exposure to full-stack development.

Worked on two major internal projects: MediStock, a full-stack material reservation tool developed with React and Flask and SalesChamp, a B2B-focused CRM enhancement. Focused on frontend development, state management, database design and implementing secure user interactions. Collaborated with designers, backend engineers and business stakeholders in an agile, fast-paced environment.
